User.title: User Profile
User.description: Registered pharmacist or pharmacy owner user profile

uid.description: Unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user

pharmacyName.description: Name of the pharmacist's pharmacy in Iraq

licenseNumber.description: Pharmacist syndicate license number for MOH validation

governorate.description: Iraq governorate where the pharmacy resides

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was initialized

Medicine.title: Medicine Stock Item
Medicine.description: Stock medicine item stored in the pharmacy inventory

nameAr.description: Arabic brand name of the drug

nameEn.description: English brand name of the drug

warehouse.description: Source scientific office or drug warehouse in Iraq

price.description: Sale price in Iraqi Dinars (IQD) per unit

availableQuantity.description: Current on-hand physical stock quantity in the pharmacy

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the stock or details were modified

B2BOrder.title: B2B Supplier Order
B2BOrder.description: B2B wholesale restocking order placed with scientific offices or warehouses

id.description: Unique supply order tracking ID (e.g., CAP-xxxxx)

warehouseName.description: Name of the supply partner/warehouse drug center

totalAmount.description: Total purchase invoice amount in IQD

status.description: Order delivery status (pending, preparing, on_way, delivered, cancelled)

SaleRecord.title: POS Sales Receipt
SaleRecord.description: Recorded retail customer sales transactions through Point of Sale register

subtotal.description: Cart items sum price in IQD

total.description: Final collected revenue amount in IQD

customerName.description: Name of the target client patient

isControlled.description: True if transaction includes MOH monitored psychotic/narcotic elements

ControlledPrescription.title: Narcotic monitored prescription record
ControlledPrescription.description: Medical controlled narcology paper validation form monitored by Ministry of Health audit

prescriptionDate.description: Stamp date of drug order issue

medicineName.description: Monitored chemical compound trade or active formula name

quantity.description: Authorized dosage quantity units in integers

pharmacistLicense.description: Syndicate license ID verifying the pharmacist in charge of dispatch

userId.description: UID of the executing validator pharmacist

TeamMember.title: Staff/Team Member
TeamMember.description: Staff and pharmacy employees permitted access or logging duty hours

/users/{userId}.description: Store individual pharmacist profile definitions at their unique Auth UID document path

/users/{userId}/inventory/{medicineId}.description: The stock items tracked within the private database inventory of the pharmacy

/users/{userId}/b2bOrders/{orderId}.description: Private restock and distribution invoices submitted to drug offices

/users/{userId}/salesLedger/{invoiceId}.description: Register sales invoice receipts generated on outer terminal

/users/{userId}/narcoticPrescriptions/{p.description: Regulatory controlled drug registers and clinical patient audit logs

/users/{userId}/teamMembers/{memberId}.description: Verified pharmacy staff roster data assigned under manager scope
